questions.stem: What do the ISO 55000 series standards provide guidance on?
options: Managing assets effectively within an organisation, including treating data as a valuable asset
questions.explanation: ISO 55000, 55001, 55012 and 55013 provide guidance and best practices for managing assets effectively, with data increasingly treated as a valuable asset.

questions.stem: How does ISO 55000 encourage organisations to view data?
options: As a strategic asset that enhances decision quality, mitigates risk and optimises asset performance
As a disposable by-product of operations
As something to be deleted after each reporting cycle
As relevant only to IT departments
As a liability to be minimised
questions.explanation: ISO 55000 encourages organisations to recognise data as a strategic asset, acknowledging its potential to enhance decision quality, mitigate risks and optimise asset performance.

options: A list of country names and codes
A comprehensive framework to establish, implement and continually improve asset management systems
questions.explanation: ISO 55001, a core component of the series, provides a comprehensive framework for organisations to establish, implement and continually improve their asset management systems.

questions.stem: Across which span of the asset lifecycle does ISO 55001 call for systematic data management?
options: Only while the asset is under warranty
questions.explanation: ISO 55001 emphasises the need for systematic approaches to managing data throughout the entire asset lifecycle, from acquisition to disposal.

questions.stem: What is the focus of the new ISO 55012 guidance?
options: People involvement and competence, including how people manage data, information and knowledge in asset management
questions.explanation: ISO 55012, Guidance on People Involvement and Competence, explores the human dimension of asset management, including how people manage data, information and knowledge.

questions.stem: What is the title of the new ISO 55013 guidance?
options: Guidance on the Management of Data Assets
questions.explanation: ISO 55013 is titled Guidance on the Management of Data Assets and examines the pivotal role of data within asset management.

questions.stem: Which of the following is one of the primary clauses of ISO 55013?
questions.explanation: ISO 55013's clauses include Managing Asset Data, Delivering Value from Asset Data, Identifying Data Assets, Managing Data Assets and Governance.

questions.stem: In the ISO 55000 series, how is efficiency distinguished from effectiveness in data management?
options: Efficiency means storing more data, effectiveness means storing less
Efficiency applies to hardware, effectiveness applies to software
Efficiency means handling data right, effectiveness means using the right data
Efficiency is measured annually, effectiveness monthly
There is no distinction between them
questions.explanation: The standards aim to help organisations manage data in a way that is both efficient (handling data right) and effective (using the right data) to meet their goals.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT listed as a reason the ISO 55000 series matters for data?
options: Efficiency, reducing waste and unnecessary costs
Risk management for reliable and secure data operations
Consistency through standardised practices and terminology
Guaranteeing that data never needs to be deleted
All of these are listed reasons
questions.explanation: The reasons listed are efficiency, risk management and consistency; the standards actually emphasise managing data from creation to deletion, not avoiding deletion.

questions.stem: In the video game analogy for the ISO 55000 series, what do the guidelines help creators do?
options: Set the price of the game
Take care of the game's data from creation until it is no longer used, including fixing bugs and deciding when to update or replace it
questions.explanation: The analogy describes the standards as guidelines that help creators care for the data in a game or app from design to retirement, keep it running smoothly, fix bugs and decide when to update or replace it.
